snippet.title: 🥐 Bakery-Style Aloo Puff | Crispy, Flaky & Delicious!
snippet.description:
🥔🥐 Bakery-Style Aloo Puff | Crispy, Flaky & Delicious!
Craving those classic Indian bakery puffs? 😍 Make them at home with flaky puff pastry filled with spicy masala aloo, green peas, and aromatic Indian spices. These golden, crispy puffs are perfect for evening chai, lunchboxes, or a quick snack! ☕️✨
Ingredients 📝
For the potato filling:
* 1 tbsp oil
* 1 tsp cumin seeds (jeera)
* A pinch of hing
* 2 green chilies, finely chopped
* 1 tsp grated ginger
* 1 small onion, finely chopped
* ¼ cup frozen green peas
* 1 tbsp coriander-cumin powder
* ½ tsp turmeric powder
* ½ tsp garam masala
* 1 tbsp Kashmiri red chili powder
* Salt to taste
* 3–4 boiled potatoes, mashed
For the puffs:
* 2 puff pastry sheets, thawed
Method 👩‍🍳
1. Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and hing. Once fragrant, add green chilies, ginger, and onion. Sauté until the onion softens.
2. Add green peas and cook for 2–3 minutes.
3. Add all the spices and salt. Mix well.
4. Add mashed potatoes, combine everything, and let the filling cool completely.
5. Cut each puff pastry sheet into 4 squares.
6. Add the potato filling to each square, fold into triangles or rectangles, and seal the edges with a fork.
7. Bake in a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C) for 10–12 minutes, or until golden and puffed. If needed, broil briefly for extra browning, watching closely to prevent burning.
Serve hot with ketchup or green chutney and a cup of chai! 😋
